text:
Gold Price in 1969
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1969, the LBMA gold price fell 17.3% between 1969-01-31 ($42.54) and 1969-12-31 ($35.20). The highest sampled price was $43.60 in April and the lowest was $35.20 in December. The mean of these observations was $40.79. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
